description: Ordered list of checkpoints for one feature or migration. Written by the checkpoint-planner skill, reviewed by the human in the viewer.

description.description: One paragraph: scope of this checkpoint.

done_criteria.description: Concrete, checkable conditions for 'this checkpoint is done'.

evidence.description: Path to archived evidence for this checkpoint, e.g. .helix/evidence/cp-01/.

id.description: Stable id, e.g. cp-01. Order in the array is the build order.

needs_ui_gate.description: False for logic-only checkpoints (they skip Gate 2 with a recorded reason).

title.description: A few words. The human reviews the sequence, not essays.

reference.description: The reference used as the spec: path to existing screen/app, or design/doc paths for new work.

target.description: What is being built or migrated, in one line.

title: Helix Loop checkpoint plan
